species: The fragmentation spectra were searched against the Homo sapiens Uniprot database (downloaded on 23-12-2013), using Andromeda as the search engine.
tissue: Phosphofractions of tumor samples purified by Ti(IV)-IMAC were analyzed by high-resolution, accurate-mass, tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS), which yielded ~1.5 million spectra.
disease_state: In vivo phosphoproteomics reveals kinase activity profiles that predict treatment outcome in triple-negative breast cancer
sample_source: Protein samples were digested using the filter-aided sample preparation method Briefly, 250 μg of each tumor and cell line protein extract dissolved in lysis buffer was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 20 min at 56 °C and alkylated using 50 mM IAA solution for 20 min at 25 °C in the dark.
anatomic_site_tumor: Sixty-three of these phosphosites have not previously been shown to be related to breast cancer.
cell_line: MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-157, Hs578T, MDA-MB-468, HCC1937, HCC1143, HCC38, BT549, BT483, MDA-MB-415

A panel of human triple negative breast cancer cell lines (MDA-MB-231, MDA-MB-157, Hs578T, MDA-MB-468, HCC1937, HCC1143, HCC38, BT549, BT483, and MDA-MB-415) was acquired from the American Type Culture Collection (ATCC).
